account.guide.title: Account setup examples
account.guide.aws.name: Singapore project archive
account.guide.aws.origin: Find the bucket’s Region in the Amazon S3 console. This example uses Singapore. You can leave the endpoint empty to use the standard endpoint for that Region.
account.guide.aws.keys: Create an access key under Security credentials for an authorized IAM user, or request one from your administrator. Save the access key ID and secret access key when issued. Temporary credentials also require the matching session token.
account.guide.aws.next: Once credentials are configured, open the object browser, choose this account and list buckets. If access is limited to one bucket, enter its name and open it directly.
account.guide.r2.name: Project assets on R2
account.guide.r2.origin: Copy the S3 API endpoint from the R2 page in your Cloudflare dashboard. Replace the example account ID with yours. For a jurisdiction-specific bucket, use the corresponding endpoint from the dashboard.
account.guide.r2.keys: Create a token for the target bucket under R2 API tokens and use the generated S3 access key ID and secret access key. Downloads require read access, uploads require write access too.
account.guide.r2.next: Once credentials are configured, open the object browser, choose this account, enter the name of your permitted R2 bucket and open it.
account.guide.oss.name: Hangzhou asset library
account.guide.oss.origin: Open the bucket overview in the Alibaba Cloud OSS console to find its region and public endpoint. This example uses the Hangzhou service endpoint.
account.guide.oss.keys: OSS uses the AccessKey ID and AccessKey Secret of an authorized RAM user, managed in the Alibaba Cloud RAM console.
account.guide.oss.next: Review the saved name, region and endpoint in the account list. OSS bucket browsing and transfers are pending.
account.guide.tos.name: Beijing project backups
account.guide.tos.origin: Open your bucket in the Volcengine TOS console and find its region and public endpoint. This example uses the Beijing service endpoint. The bucket name is separate from that endpoint.
account.guide.tos.keys: In Volcengine IAM access key management, obtain the Access Key ID and Secret Access Key for an identity granted access to the bucket.
account.guide.tos.next: Review the Beijing region and endpoint in the account list and edit them if needed. TOS bucket browsing and transfers are pending.
account.guide.s3-compatible.name: Team object storage
account.guide.s3-compatible.origin: Ask the service administrator for the S3 API endpoint and signing region. Replace these example values with those for your service.
account.guide.s3-compatible.keys: Request an S3 access key ID and secret access key scoped to the target bucket from the service administrator.
account.guide.s3-compatible.next: Review the endpoint and signing region in the account list. Bucket browsing and transfers for generic S3 services are pending.
